kubectl_manifest.cluster_pca_issuer applies a manifest of kind AWSPCAClusterIssuer, a CRD installed by the aws-privateca-issuer add-on that is deployed via module.eks_blueprints_kubernetes_addons (enable_aws_privateca_issuer = true). The resource currently only depends on the eks_cluster_id output and the CA resource, so Terraform may apply it before the CRD/controller exists, causing an apply failure ("no matches for kind AWSPCAClusterIssuer"). It should depend on module.eks_blueprints_kubernetes_addons (as example_pca_certificate already does). No clean data-reference fix exists because that module exports no attribute referencing the CRD.

aws_eks_node_group.managed_ng already depends implicitly on aws_iam_role.managed_ng through node_role_arn = aws_iam_role.managed_ng[0].arn; listing aws_iam_role.managed_ng again in depends_on is redundant.

null_resource.update_trust_policy already depends implicitly on aws_iam_role.emr_on_eks_execution because its local-exec command references ${aws_iam_role.emr_on_eks_execution.id}; the explicit depends_on entry duplicates that implicit dependency.

null_resource.update_trust_policy already depends implicitly on kubernetes_namespace.spark because its local-exec command references ${kubernetes_namespace.spark.id}; the explicit depends_on entry duplicates that implicit dependency.
